paragraphs: R. Marinos, Niddah 37a. Rav Yosef said the law follows R. Marinos, Af Al Pi 60a. Ḥezkat HaBatim 56a: R. Marinos explained in his name. Rashbam explains: in R. Yoḥanan's name; Tosafot says in R. Elazar's name. Marinos was guarantor for his daughter-in-law, and they litigated before R. Ḥama, father of bar Kappara and R. Hoshaya—apparently a scribal error: it should read R. Ḥama, R. Hoshaya's father, and bar Kappara. They asked R. Ḥiyya the elder; R. Ḥiyya asked Rabbi, Jerusalem Talmud, Shevuot 6, halakhah 2. R. Marinos and R. Ḥanina both spoke in Abba Nehorai’s name, Bereshit Rabbah, end of section 91.
